text:
Maya: quick question  I'm putting together a minimal proposal to normalize response status tokens + telemetry tags so SDKs, SRE, and the console all read the same signal. want eyeballs before I PR.
Jon: ok, high level? are we changing HTTP semantics or just adding structured headers?
Maya: only additive. keep HTTP codes as-is. add a compact header `X-Rdwd-Status-Token` and a small telemetry tag `X-Rdwd-Tags` (semicolon-delimited). examples below.
Priya: please avoid free-text reasons in headers. they leak internal names into logs and break aggregation. compact tokens + a public mapping is the right move.
Maya: example response sketch:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Rdwd-Status-Token: QUOTA_LIMIT
X-Rdwd-Status-Sub: USER_BUCKET
X-Rdwd-Tags: mapping_v=2024.02;zone=us-west-2
Retry-After: 30
```
Liam: Retry-After is useful. SDKs can use Retry-After as authoritative for backoff windows; token class tells whether retrying is safe. define token classes like: RETRYABLE, TERMINAL, SOFT_DEGRADE.
Maya: yes. propose mapping file fields: token, class, http_status, console_key, internationalization_key. mapping_v versioned by YYYY.MM.
Priya: telemetry ask  add `status.token` and `status.mapping_v` as span attributes in traces. makes troubleshooting in APM trivial.
ops-bot: I can add aggregation for `X-Rdwd-Status-Token` and emit daily counts to infra.metrics. Want threshold config?
Maya: start with alert when RATE(token=QUOTA_LIMIT) increases by 10x in 10m or absolute > 1000/min. tune later.
Jon: console UX: show a short human message and an expandable pane with raw token + mapping link. hide raw token by default, reveal on click. copy example: "Rate limit reached  try again later" with a link "Why?".
Ursula: language/internationalization note: mapping should reference keys, not the literal English copy. front-end will render localized text. add `console_key` to mapping.
Maya: SDK snippet prototype (pseudocode):
```js
const token = resp.headers['x-rdwd-status-token'];
const cls = mapping.tokens[token].class;
if (cls === 'RETRYABLE') scheduleRetry(resp.headers['retry-after'] || defaultBackoff);
else showTerminalError();
```
Priya: please publish mapping as a small JSON API (GET /v1/mappings/status_tokens?version=latest). SDKs can cache it and optionally pin version.
Maya: rollout plan suggestion:
- shadow emit headers for 2 weeks
- publish mapping_v and API
- opt-in SDK flag to consume tokens
- 60-day notice then flip SDK default to on
- after 120 days remove verbose text headers

Liam: I want a compatibility guarantee doc: renaming tokens must be a major mapping_v and we promise N days of overlap. Sylvia (not on thread) will own the policy?
Priya: add a single test matrix in the PR that verifies: header present, token in mapping, mapping_v matches telemetry tag.
ops-bot: acknowledged. will open infra/metrics PR for token counts and a playbook entry for token-based incident creation.
Maya: dashboards: sample KQL for the console team:
```
index=redwood-logs | where headers.X_Rdwd_Status_Token == "QUOTA_LIMIT" | stats count() by tenant_id, bin(1m)
```
Jon: nice. also add a small console filter that queries the logs for mapping_v so customers can see whether a problem happened under an old mapping.
Ursula: can we add a small tooltip in the console: "Why you saw this: [localized message]. See full technical details" and link to mapping API.
Maya: ownership: I'll author the header spec + mapping schema, Jon will mock console UI and PR copy, Priya will add telemetry changes and the test matrix, Liam will take compatibility policy, ops-bot will add metrics.
ops-bot: created infra/metrics/pr-99 (https://git.redwood/infra/metrics/pulls/99) and playbook note.
Maya: thanks. I'll post a short RFC doc (WIP) and tag this thread: https://redwood.dev/rfc/status-token-normalization. please review before EOD tomorrow.
Jon: will do, thanks.
